name: Type, form, space, time: a designer's index card opens four chapters and closes them, each born from an orange dot

source.location: external: user reference folder (resolve with --root or MOTION_REFERENCE_ROOTS); never copied into the repository
source.creator: unknown

rights.attribution: Unknown creator; supplied by the user as a private study reference.

brand_assets.description: Designer's name with an orange full stop and role on the card

rights.notes: Rights unverified. A personal reel; reuse the index-card structure and the orange-dot hinges only, with original type and pieces.

analysis.inspected_by: agent (GitHub Copilot, Session F) using the reference-analyst workflow
analysis.method: Viewed overview (20 frames), transitions strips at all 5 boundaries (every 2nd frame), the listen sheet (2 phrases, 10 accent hits) and a 30 fps strip at 4.40-4.90 s (the bloom into the second chapter). Strips at 1.7-2.1 and 10.1-10.8 s were generated but not viewed; a strip at 5.5-7.2 s hung and was stopped. Signal features and Windows en-US dictation; nothing was listened to.
analysis.coverage: Full 15.07 s (1280x720, 30 fps); all boundaries at 2-frame steps; the bloom at 30 fps.

concept.observed: A motion designer's reel organised as a table of contents: an index card lists four chapters (type, form, space, time); each chapter is one short style piece; the film returns to the card, now with an icon per chapter.
concept.interpreted: The structure itself is the claim of range.

communication_style.observed: Music only; each chapter's word is the picture.

palette.observed: Cream paper (#f8e8e8, 37%), vermilion orange (#f85818, 17%), black, ultramarine and marigold in the shape grid and blocks; black frame around the card.

typography.observed: Didone-like serif name with an orange full stop; heavy black grotesque chapter words; a script italic with a 3D extruded shadow; stencil-like geometric letters for the second chapter; small mono labels in the corners.

motion.observed: The card flips up in perspective (0.10-0.45 s); black bars build the first word (1.88-2.08 s); outline echoes stack above and below it (2.86-3.0 s); it morphs into the script word (3.4-3.8 s); a badge rotates (4.2 s); Bauhaus tiles rotate and swap on the beat (5.6-7.2 s); an orange ball rolls through isometric blocks (7.9-10.1 s); particles form the fourth word over a clock dial and concentric arcs turn (10.9-13.1 s); the name's letters reassemble on the card (13.15-13.48 s).

transitions.observed: 0.10 s soft: the card flips in. 1.87 s cut: an orange dot grows at the name's full stop (1.82 s), then a cut to orange as bars build the first word. 4.57 s soft: an orange disc with rings blooms from behind the script word and lands as the O of the next word (4.57-4.73 s, 0.16 s). 10.43 s soft: the camera blur-zooms into the orange ball until orange fills the frame (10.12-10.32 s), then a dark frame where an orange dot blooms into a particle ring (10.45-10.78 s). 13.13 s cut back to the card.
transitions.interpreted: The orange dot is the hinge of every chapter change: full stop, O, ball, dot.

timing_and_rhythm.observed: Card 1.9 s; chapters of about 2.7, 3.0, 4.6 and 2.7 s; card 1.9 s.

sound_design.observed: -12.5 LUFS, LRA 0.8 LU, true peak +0.5 dBTP (above 0); tempo 129.2 bpm (medium); 47 onsets; 10 accents (39.8/min). Accents on boundaries 0 of 5 (chance 0.12); onsets within 67 ms of boundaries 0.6 (chance 0.34), median 62 ms; near the beat 0.4 (chance 0.26). Accents 0.46-0.49 s apart (one beat at 129 bpm) from 2.39 to 7.08 s, each on an arrival: the first word settles (2.39 s), its echoes (2.86 s), the script word (3.81 s), the badge (4.27 s), the O (4.74 s), tile swaps (5.67, 6.13, 6.62, 7.08 s); then one at 11.77 s (the particle word). No accents in the 3D block chapter (7.1-11.7 s) or after 11.77 s. No silences; head -11.4 dB, tail -1.9 dB. Accents may be part of the music.
sound_design.interpreted: Same split as the corpus: changes sit near onsets, strong accents go to arrivals.

narration.observed: None: dictation kept 4 confident words (20 raw) as two phrases over the shape grid and blocks (7.14-8.46 s) and the particle word and card (9.88-14.09 s); no speaker.
narration.interpreted: Text-led film: the copy is on screen, timed to the music.

captions.observed: No captions. Copy: the card (name top-left, role, a four-line index right) at both ends; one chapter word per chapter, centred or on the floor of the 3D scene; small corner labels.

scenes.observed: An index card flips in: name, role, four chapters.
Chapter 1: a heavy word, echoes, a script morph, a badge.
Chapter 2: the O blooms; a grid of Bauhaus shapes.
Chapter 3: isometric blocks and a rolling ball.
Chapter 4: a dot blooms into particles; a word and a clock.
Back to the card, now with an icon per chapter.

moments.observed: An orange disc with soft rings blooms from behind the script word and settles as the O of the next chapter word in 0.16 s (4.57-4.73 s).
moments.interpreted: The accent dot carries the viewer into the next chapter.

difficult: The isometric block field with soft shadows and depth of field (7.9-10.1 s) reads as a 3D render
The particle word over a clock dial needs Canvas 2D or a plate
uncertainties: Whether the end-card name is a person's name or a brand
Exact timing of the 1.82-1.88 s dot growth (sheet only)
